name: Dotfiles (GNU Stow)
description: Mounts host dotfiles directory and manages configuration symlinks via GNU Stow inside devcontainer.

packages.description: Comma-separated list of dotfiles packages to stow (e.g. 'nvim,tmux,gemini'). If empty, all subdirectories are stowed.

target.description: Target directory to stow files into. Defaults to user $HOME.
